note: *chifre* opens and closes the canticle, as the row across the psalter; the blind reader heard a literal horn. *força* and *fronte* the options.
*Não multipliqueis palavras altivas*: both Latinist gates asked *o falar de coisas altivas*; *multiplicar* takes no infinitive in Portuguese (D2).

*faz descer aos infernos*, the *dedúcere* row's verb; canticle 212 (13:2) still has *conduzis*, ruled together. The blind reader heard hell. The Diurnal's *à morada dos mortos* the option; the LH and Lectionary say *à sepultura*.
*do seu Cristo* by D19; the LH, Lectionary and Diurnal say *o seu Ungido*. No finished psalm has *Ungido*. The blind reader heard Jesus Christ.
